messages:
alex_m: SOLUCorp requested a 6mo dedicated commit. Needs sustained 4x H100 equiv, burst to 8 for traffic spikes. They're asking for 25% off list reserved rate and a 2-week POC to validate throughput. Also flagged KMS/HSM + private control plane as must-have. Can we confirm pricing + approvals?

sophia_sales: Thanks Alex. What's their expected average RPS and token/sec? Do they plan steady or spiky workload? Need numbers for deal desk.

alex_m: They're projecting ~15k tokens/s steady, p95 latency target <300ms. Spikes up to ~40k tokens/s during events. POC will run a synthetic load that mirrors that.

jordan_revenuemgr: 25% looks aggressive for a 6mo term. Our standard 6mo tier is ~15-18% depending on commit size. We can consider 20% if they commit to 4 units minimum and sign an addendum. Anything >20% needs VP sign-off.

ellie_sol_eng: From infra: we can provision a reserved pool of 4 GPUs and an autoscale burst pool up to 8. Burst is billed pay-as-you-go at +50% on the per-GPU unit price while bursting. We can run a 2-week POC in a sandbox org (no billing for reserved during POC) but note: private control plane + KMS requires security review and SOW — longer lead time.

sophia_sales: @jordan_revenuemgr can you confirm 20% is OK conditioned on the addendum? If VP approval needed, what's ETA?

jordan_revenuemgr: 20% is OK with addendum + minimum commit. >20% needs VP. Escalation path: Deal Desk -> Rev Ops -> CRO. Expect 48-72h if we have ARR and churn mitigation notes.

ryan_pm: Proposed POC success criteria: 1) sustained p95 latency <300ms for typical requests, 2) survive spike to 40k tokens/s with <5% error rate, 3) KV cache hit rate >=70%. Agree?

alex_m: Agree. Customer will provide prompt set and synthetic driver. Need an eng contact for setup.

ellie_sol_eng: I'll own infra for the POC. Need a service account + access to their test dataset. For private control plane + KMS, eng-security will need to run the questionnaire — estimate 3-4 weeks for review and SOW.

eng-security: @ellie_sol_eng noted. We'll need the completed security questionnaire, key lifecycle docs, and any cert requirements. Confirm whether keys remain customer-managed (preferred) or Redwood-managed.

sophia_sales: I'll send the questionnaire and SOW draft to the customer today. Alex — can you confirm expected ARR to include in the deal packet?

alex_m: They estimate ~$1.2M ARR on the commit, ramping over 3 months.

jordan_revenuemgr: Addendum checklist for Deal Desk: 1) commit size (4 reserved + burst to 8), 2) price (20% off list conditioned on signed addendum), 3) burst billing term (+50% on per-GPU unit while bursting), 4) POC clause (2-week sandbox, no billing for reserved), 5) termination & SLA language. I created ticket DD-4832.

deal-desk-bot: New deal desk ticket created: DD-4832. Assigned to @jordan_revenuemgr. Link: https://redwood.internal/dd/DD-4832 :white_check_mark:

sophia_sales: Next steps: I'll send SOW + questionnaire; Jordan will draft addendum; Ellie & eng-security start POC infra readiness. Target POC start next Tue (3 business days).

ryan_pm: I'll prepare the test harness and Grafana dashboard for POC metrics. Need prometheus endpoints and token-level cost reporting enabled for the sandbox.

alex_m: Thanks everyone. If VP approval is required, ping me and I'll prep an exec summary. :thumbsup:
